# The opening parenthesis lines that a comment can be above are lines that
# hold only opening parentheses, with optional white space between them.
celfmt -i double.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_double.txt

celfmt -i spaced.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_spaced.txt

# A comment on the parenthesis line follows the comment above that line.
celfmt -i trailing.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_trailing.txt

celfmt -i want_trailing.txt
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_trailing.txt

-- double.cel --
state.with(
	// c1
	((
		state.x
	)).as(y, {"a": y})
)
-- want_double.txt --
state.with(
	// c1
	state.x.as(y, {"a": y})
)
-- spaced.cel --
state.with(
	// c2
	( (
		state.x
	) ).as(y, {"a": y})
)
-- want_spaced.txt --
state.with(
	// c2
	state.x.as(y, {"a": y})
)
-- trailing.cel --
state.with(
	// c3
	( // c4
		state.x
	).as(y, {"a": y})
)
-- want_trailing.txt --
state.with(
	// c3
	// c4
	state.x.as(y, {"a": y})
)
